rows.grounds: Qualifies the subtle aspect of mahāmāyā introduced in the preceding division.
Names the first principle in the series; first member of a compound with ādi.
Indicates a series starting from kalā; second member of the compound kalā-ādi.
Denotes the set of principles beginning with kalā.
Expresses non-differentiation; first member of compound with svarūpiṇī.
Predicates the essential nature of the subtle aspect as undifferentiated.

items.question: What essential nature defines the subtle aspect of mahāmāyā with respect to the principles beginning with kalā?
premises: Mahāmāyā is divided into three aspects, including a subtle one.
The subtle aspect is related to the principles beginning with kalā.
Its defining character is the non-differentiation of those principles.
items.inference: Therefore the subtle aspect of mahāmāyā consists in the undifferentiated state of the principles beginning with kalā.
uncertainties: The exact range of principles included by kalā-ādi is not specified within this verse.
items.plain_english: The subtle aspect has as its nature the undivided state of the principles beginning with kalā.
